text: This might be a silly one. My stepdaughter is 9 and her temperature went up to 39.9 tonight. She's got a rash on her back and chest, little pinky blotches. I did the glass test her dad told me about and they all go pale when you press, so I think that's the good kind? Her eczema's flared up too, the dry patches on her elbows and behind her knees, she's been scratching them raw. She's weeing fine, been to the loo a few times tonight, and her breathing's normal, I sat and watched her for a bit. There's a big purple bruise on her shin but she came off the climbing frame at the park yesterday and banged it, so I know where that's from. Don't want to overreact but 39.9 seemed high
